name: intralogistics-flow-analyzer
description: Community Edition for deterministic warehouse-flow analysis, spaghetti diagrams and constraint-safe slotting simulations.

interface.longDescription: A local, deterministic Python engine that turns structured warehouse exports into modelled route metrics, spaghetti diagrams and constraint-safe slotting simulations. Real exports are analysed with the 'ifa' command line on your own machine; the bundled MCP server is a read-only demonstration over fictional datasets.
defaultPrompt: Validate and analyze the supplied warehouse dataset, or run the fictional demonstration dataset when no customer data is provided.
Run the fictional demonstration dataset and explain what the engine produces.
Generate a spaghetti diagram of the modelled pick routes.
